//: Deploy the frontend only. Set the Vercel project's Root Directory to
'frontend' and copy this file there, or run `vercel --cwd frontend`.
NEXT_PUBLIC_* values are inlined into the browser bundle at build time, so
they must be set as Vercel environment variables before the first build.
Changing them requires a redeploy, not just a restart.
Then set CORS_ORIGINS and APP_URL on the API to this Vercel origin, and
point the GitHub OAuth callback at the API. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
